## Purpose
The decision cards shared by the agent orchestrator and the workflow planner. Each renders the evidence one layer produced, attached to its row in the timeline.

## Responsibilities
- `Rationale`.
- `GuardrailView` / `ModerationGuardrailCard`, with a threshold band from `bandFor`.
- `LibraryProvisionedView` / `Card`.
- `RulesSelectedView` / `Card`, and `RuleOutcomesCard` (with RulePills).

The exports listed.
